<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapItemKeyFrameTrack</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Stores keyframes for interpolation of a map item property using a specific
 easing function and interpolation mode.
 <p>The keyframe track object is used to create animations,
 see <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmarkeranimation" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation"><code>MapMarkerAnimation</code></a> and <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolylineanimation" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation"><code>MapPolylineAnimation</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a id="moveTo(java.util.List,com.here.sdk.animation.Easing,com.here.sdk.animation.KeyframeInterpolationMode)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>moveTo</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public static&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack</a>&nbsp;moveTo&#8203;(@NonNull
                                          java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geocoordinateskeyframe" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">GeoCoordinatesKeyframe</a>&gt;&nbsp;keyframes,
                                          @NonNull
                                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-easing" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">Easing</a>&nbsp;easing,
                                          @NonNull
                                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-keyframeinterpolationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.animation">KeyframeInterpolationMode</a>&nbsp;interpolationMode)
                                   throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a map item position keyframe track. It enables animations over the geographical
 coordinates where the map item is positioned.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>keyframes</code> - <p>The list of keyframes that specify how the map item position changes over time.</dd>
<dd><code>easing</code> - <p>The easing to apply during keyframe interpolation.</dd>
<dd><code>interpolationMode</code> - <p>The type of interpolation done between keyframe values.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>MapItemKeyFrameTrack instance.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>If the supplied keyframe list is empty or first keyframe duration is not 0.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="polylineProgress(java.util.List,com.here.sdk.animation.Easing,com.here.sdk.animation.KeyframeInterpolationMode)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>polylineProgress</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public static&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack</a>&nbsp;polylineProgress&#8203;(@NonNull
                                                    java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-scalarkeyframe" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">ScalarKeyframe</a>&gt;&nbsp;keyframes,
                                                    @NonNull
                                                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-easing" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">Easing</a>&nbsp;easing,
                                                    @NonNull
                                                    <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-keyframeinterpolationmode" title="enum in com.here.sdk.animation">KeyframeInterpolationMode</a>&nbsp;interpolationMode)
                                             throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a keyframe track used to animate the progress of a polyline.
 <p>Each scalar keyframe specifies the progress property
 (as passed to <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline#setProgress(double)"><code>MapPolyline.setProgress(double)</code></a>) at key points of the animation.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>keyframes</code> - <p>The list of keyframes that specify how the polyline progress changes
     over time.</dd>
<dd><code>easing</code> - <p>The easing to apply during keyframe interpolation.</dd>
<dd><code>interpolationMode</code> - <p>The type of interpolation done between keyframe values.</dd>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>MapItemKeyFrameTrack instance.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapitemkeyframetrack-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.animation">MapItemKeyFrameTrack.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>If the supplied keyframe list is empty or first keyframe duration is not 0.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
